prompt: Draw a PlantUML sequence diagram of a user signing in with a one-time code sent by SMS, between User, Web App, Auth Service and SMS Provider.
Draw a PlantUML class diagram for a hotel booking system with Hotel, Room, Guest and Booking, including key attributes.
Draw a PlantUML activity diagram for handling a customer return: check the receipt, inspect the item, then refund or reject.
Draw a PlantUML Gantt chart for a four-task office move starting on 2027-03-01: plan, pack, move, unpack, each task following the previous one.
Add an Email Service that the Order Service calls after saving the order, to send a confirmation email.
startCode:
@startuml
actor Customer
participant "Web App" as Web
participant "Order Service" as Orders
database "Orders DB" as DB
Customer -> Web : Place order
Web -> Orders : createOrder()
Orders -> DB : INSERT order
DB --> Orders : ok
Orders --> Web : order id
Web --> Customer : Confirmation page
@enduml
